text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's time for the Japan Cup. Everyone has their attention on Hishi Amazon, and they're looking forward to her showdown with Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's something Hishi Amazon must do. Narita Brian once told her that there's someone she wishes to overtake…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Now, Hishi Amazon wants to become the impetus for Narita Brian to keep running! She aims high, vowing to emerge victorious.
